Independently reproduced the failed 0.95 RMSE-ratio criterion and the three passing val guard gates, including the pooled 3/8-second trajectory comparisons.

next_route.mechanism_diagnosis: On the complete synthetic train roster, inspect the trajectory and margin parameter-gradient norms, their alignment, and the algebraic Adam update directions at the common frozen initial state. Loss magnitudes alone do not establish why the objectives produce similar updates.
next_route.single_candidate_change: If the gradient diagnosis supports a scale mismatch, consider one margin weight computed once as the complete-train trajectory-gradient norm divided by the complete-train margin-gradient norm, then freeze it. Reject a degenerate or effectively unchanged update direction instead of sweeping weights.
next_route.validation_design: Preregister a new near-threshold synthetic excitation design with every declared case retained and no outcome-based resampling. Keep the frozen physical classification rule and the complete 8-second coverage, false-alarm and trajectory guards.
next_route.evidence_boundary: The current initial train and val models already trigger every matched positive witness, so this completed experiment does not measure recovery of missed-instability cases. No real-data training, val/test threshold change or follow-up scientific execution is approved here.
